topic.title: Probabilistic Generative Modeling and Marginal Inference
topic.overview: These methods learn probability distributions that can generate data, answer conditional questions, and evaluate partially observed examples. The central challenge is making a flexible distribution computationally usable: exact likelihoods, posterior inference, and marginal probabilities can become expensive even when drawing a sample is easy. Representatives explore energy-based models, stochastic transitions, bidirectional inference, and explicitly learned marginals.
topic.whyItMatters: A useful generator should support reasoning about missing information as well as realistic outputs. Choosing a training divergence or enforcing consistency between marginals can change both the statistical behavior and the cost of those operations.
topic.evolution: The examples span binary and directional Boltzmann models in the early 1990s, stochastic generative networks and bidirectional models in the 2010s, and recent marginalization, distribution embeddings, and constrained sampling. This is a widening collection of computational formulations, not evidence that one family universally replaces another.
openQuestions: How can efficient marginal queries retain reliable uncertainty in high dimensions?
Which consistency constraints improve sampling without restricting useful distributional structure?

papers.title: Localization with Sampling-Argmax
papers.tldr: Sampling-argmax improves localization training by minimizing sampled position errors, implicitly constraining the predicted probability map.

papers.title: On the Generative Utility of Cyclic Conditionals
papers.tldr: CyGen models data through two cyclic conditional distributions, supported by theory about when they define a compatible and unique joint distribution.

papers.title: Pseudo-Spherical Contrastive Divergence
papers.tldr: PS-CD generalizes contrastive divergence to flexible energy-model objectives that avoid partition-function computation and show robustness to contaminated data.

papers.title: Score-based Generative Neural Networks for Large-Scale Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: A score-based generative framework learns regularized transport couplings and samples target data conditioned on source examples.

papers.title: A Differential Entropy Estimator for Training Neural Networks
papers.tldr: KNIFE makes kernel-based differential entropy estimation differentiable and adaptable for use in neural network training.

papers.title: A Functional Information Perspective on Model Interpretation
papers.tldr: The paper uses functional information measures to explain feature contributions and reports improvements over sampling-based interpretation methods.

papers.title: Forward Operator Estimation in Generative Models with Kernel Transfer Operators
papers.tldr: Kernel transfer operators provide a simpler generative modeling approach with favorable empirical performance and substantial runtime savings.

papers.title: Marginal Distribution Adaptation for Discrete Sets via Module-Oriented Divergence Minimization
papers.tldr: Modular adaptation updates discrete-set generative models to match target marginals while reusing learned correlations.

papers.title: Neural Inverse Transform Sampler
papers.tldr: NITS uses cumulative-distribution representations to combine efficient sampling with exact likelihood evaluation for multidimensional, compactly supported densities.

papers.title: Training Discrete Deep Generative Models via Gapped Straight-Through Estimator
papers.tldr: The Gapped Straight-Through estimator reduces gradient-estimation variance without resampling overhead and outperforms strong baselines on two evaluated discrete modeling tasks.

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-stage Density Ratio Estimation for Learning Latent Space Energy-based Model
papers.tldr: Adaptive density-ratio estimation learns a latent energy-based prior through successive updates that bridge a difficult prior–posterior gap.

papers.title: Amortized Projection Optimization for Sliced Wasserstein Generative Models
papers.tldr: Learned projection predictors replace repeated direction optimization to make sliced Wasserstein losses more practical for generative modeling.

papers.title: CARD: Classification and Regression Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: CARD combines diffusion-based conditional generation with a pretrained mean predictor to estimate response distributions and assess uncertainty for individual examples.

papers.title: Convergence for score-based generative modeling with polynomial complexity
papers.tldr: The paper proves polynomial sampling guarantees from accurate score estimates and explains the benefits of annealing and predictor-corrector sampling.

papers.title: Cooperative Distribution Alignment via JSD Upper Bound
papers.tldr: A unified invertible-transformation framework aligns distributions cooperatively by minimizing an upper bound on Jensen-Shannon divergence.

papers.title: Learning Probabilistic Models from Generator Latent Spaces with Hat EBM
papers.tldr: Hat EBM combines a generator with a residual variable to enable energy-based probabilistic modeling without latent inference or generator Jacobian determinants.

papers.title: Masked Prediction: A Parameter Identifiability View
papers.tldr: For specified Hidden Markov Models, masked-prediction task difficulty determines whether an optimal predictor identifies the underlying generative parameters.

papers.title: On Deep Generative Models for Approximation and Estimation of Distributions on Manifolds
papers.tldr: For distributions supported on low-dimensional manifolds, generative-network error rates depend on intrinsic dimension without requiring distributional smoothness.

papers.title: Posterior Matching for Arbitrary Conditioning
papers.tldr: Posterior Matching enables existing VAEs to predict arbitrary subsets of features from other observed subsets without modifying the VAE itself.

papers.title: Predictive Coding beyond Gaussian Distributions
papers.tldr: Generalizing predictive coding beyond Gaussian distributions enables Transformer training and matches or approaches backpropagation performance in the reported tasks.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Models Detect Manifolds
papers.tldr: The paper gives conditions for score-based models to generate samples on a data manifold and characterizes when they memorize training examples.

papers.title: Training and Inference on Any-Order Autoregressive Models the Right Way
papers.tldr: Reducing redundant conditionals and weighting training by inference frequency improves any-order autoregressive modeling while preserving efficient arbitrary conditioning.

papers.title: Wasserstein Iterative Networks for Barycenter Estimation
papers.tldr: The paper approximates Wasserstein barycenters with unrestricted neural architectures without introducing regularization bias and provides a dataset for evaluation.

papers.title: Cold Analysis of Rao-Blackwellized Straight-Through Gumbel-Softmax Gradient Estimator
papers.tldr: Analyzing Gumbel-Rao at zero temperature yields a simple, inexpensive gradient estimator with favorable reported bias–variance tradeoffs.

papers.title: Conditionally Strongly Log-Concave Generative Models
papers.tldr: Factoring distributions into strongly log-concave conditional pieces enables generative modeling with guarantees beyond globally log-concave distributions.

papers.title: Data-Copying in Generative Models: A Formal Framework
papers.tldr: The paper develops a more local definition of generative data-copying, a detector, and bounds on the data needed for reliable detection.

papers.title: Emergent Asymmetry of Precision and Recall for Measuring Fidelity and Diversity of Generative Models in High Dimensions
papers.tldr: Nearest-neighbor precision and recall can become misleadingly asymmetric in high dimensions, and modified metrics alleviate this problem.

papers.title: End-to-end Training of Deep Boltzmann Machines by Unbiased Contrastive Divergence with Local Mode Initialization
papers.tldr: Metropolis-Hastings coupling initialized near local modes enables efficient unbiased gradient estimation and end-to-end deep Boltzmann machine training.

papers.title: Gradient-based Wang-Landau Algorithm: A Novel Sampler for Output Distribution of Neural Networks over the Input Space
papers.tldr: Gradient-based Wang-Landau sampling estimates neural network output distributions by exploring neglected regions of the input space more efficiently.

papers.title: H-Likelihood Approach to Deep Neural Networks with Temporal-Spatial Random Effects for High-Cardinality Categorical Features
papers.tldr: The paper uses hierarchical likelihood to train neural networks with correlated random effects, providing stated exact estimation results and an online-learning procedure.

papers.title: Learning Unnormalized Statistical Models via Compositional Optimization
papers.tldr: Rewriting normalization as a stochastic compositional problem enables direct likelihood training with theoretical and empirical advantages over noise-contrastive estimation.

papers.title: On Investigating the Conservative Property of Score-Based Generative Models
papers.tldr: Quasi-conservative score models seek to preserve flexible architectures while addressing performance losses associated with nonconservative score estimates.

papers.title: On the Convergence Rate of Gaussianization with Random Rotations
papers.tldr: Gaussianization with random rotations requires layers growing linearly with dimension for Gaussian input, with similar but nonuniform empirical scaling more broadly.

papers.title: Proper Losses for Discrete Generative Models
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes sample-based proper losses for discrete generators and shows how broader sampling schemes enable cross-entropy estimation.

papers.title: Synthetic Data, Real Errors: How (Not) to Publish and Use Synthetic Data
papers.tldr: Deep Generative Ensembles account for uncertainty in synthetic-data generation, improving downstream results especially for minority classes and sparse regions.

papers.title: An Information-Theoretic Evaluation of Generative Models in Learning Multi-modal Distributions
papers.tldr: The paper uses Rényi Kernel Entropy to evaluate mode coverage and finds that tested generative models still miss some real-data diversity.

papers.title: Characteristic Circuits
papers.tldr: Characteristic circuits use characteristic functions to learn tractable distributions over heterogeneous data, including cases without closed-form densities.

papers.title: Compositional Generalization from First Principles
papers.tldr: The paper derives sufficient conditions for compositional generalization by studying the structure of the data-generating process.

papers.title: Debiasing Pretrained Generative Models by Uniformly Sampling Semantic Attributes
papers.tldr: A learned noise-distribution mapping balances semantic groups in generated outputs without retraining the generator or using real training data.

papers.title: Differentiable Random Partition Models
papers.tldr: A two-stage random partition model enables gradient-based learning of groupings with an unknown number of subsets.

papers.title: Efficient Training of Energy-Based Models Using Jarzynski Equality
papers.tldr: A weighted Langevin sampling method uses the Jarzynski equality to improve energy-based model training and address slow-mixing sampling bias.

papers.title: Energy Discrepancies: A Score-Independent Loss for Energy-Based Models
papers.tldr: Energy Discrepancy trains energy-based models without scores or expensive MCMC and connects score matching with likelihood-based learning.

papers.title: Entropy-based Training Methods for Scalable Neural Implicit Samplers
papers.tldr: Two divergence-based training methods enable neural samplers to generate batches directly, with substantial efficiency gains in the reported high-dimensional experiment.

papers.title: Feature Likelihood Divergence: Evaluating the Generalization of Generative Models Using Samples
papers.tldr: FLD evaluates generated samples for novelty, fidelity, and diversity, detecting overfitting cases that earlier metrics miss.

papers.title: Generator Born from Classifier
papers.tldr: A generator learns without data samples by making generated distributions satisfy learning-related conditions encoded in a pretrained classifier’s parameters.

papers.title: Learning a 1-layer conditional generative model in total variation
papers.tldr: The paper learns single-layer conditional generators in total variation without assumptions on the input distribution, with a conditional extension to deep models.

papers.title: Squared Neural Families: A New Class of Tractable Density Models
papers.tldr: SNEFYs turn squared neural-network outputs into flexible probability models with closed-form normalization in many cases and tractable conditioning and marginals.

papers.title: Structured Neural Networks for Density Estimation and Causal Inference
papers.tldr: StrNN masks neural-network pathways to enforce desired independencies, supporting structured density estimation and causal analysis with normalizing flows.

papers.title: Towards a Unified Framework of Contrastive Learning for Disentangled Representations
papers.tldr: The paper proves latent identifiability for four contrastive losses without common independence assumptions and examines their practical behavior.

papers.title: Versatile Energy-Based Probabilistic Models for High Energy Physics
papers.tldr: An energy-based framework models particle interactions to support event generation, anomaly detection, and particle identification.

papers.title: A Bias-Variance-Covariance Decomposition of Kernel Scores for Generative Models
papers.tldr: A kernel-score decomposition yields sample-based uncertainty measures that apply across generative domains and can assess closed-source models.

papers.title: A Diffusion Model Framework for Unsupervised Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.tldr: A new training objective enables diffusion models to tackle combinatorial optimization without example solutions or exact sample likelihoods.

papers.title: A Geometric Explanation of the Likelihood OOD Detection Paradox
papers.tldr: Combining likelihood with local dimensionality helps explain and detect unfamiliar data that generative models misleadingly score highly.

papers.title: An Interpretable Evaluation of Entropy-based Novelty of Generative Models
papers.tldr: KEN measures a generative model’s novelty relative to a reference by identifying sample types that the model produces more frequently.

papers.title: $f$-Divergence Based Classification: Beyond the Use of Cross-Entropy
papers.tldr: The paper derives classification objectives from f-divergences and introduces shifted log divergence, which achieves the highest accuracy in almost all evaluated cases.

papers.title: Generative Conditional Distributions by Neural (Entropic) Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: Two jointly trained networks use entropic optimal transport and smoothness regularization to learn generative conditional distributions, particularly with limited data.

papers.title: Generative Marginalization Models
papers.tldr: MAMs approximate arbitrary discrete marginal probabilities in one forward pass, delivering large reported speedups and more scalable energy-based generative modeling.

papers.title: InfoNet: Neural Estimation of Mutual Information without Test-Time Optimization
papers.tldr: InfoNet learns from simulated data to estimate mutual information directly, avoiding neural-network optimization at test time.

papers.title: Multi-Fidelity Residual Neural Processes for Scalable Surrogate Modeling
papers.tldr: MFRNP combines lower-fidelity model outputs and learns their residual error to improve high-fidelity surrogate predictions.

papers.title: Neural-Kernel Conditional Mean Embeddings
papers.tldr: Neural-kernel conditional mean embeddings avoid costly matrix inversion and show competitive results in density estimation and distributional reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Position: Compositional Generative Modeling: A Single Model is Not All You Need
papers.tldr: The paper argues that composing smaller generative models can improve data efficiency and enable generalization to unseen data regions and tasks.

papers.title: REMEDI: Corrective Transformations for Improved Neural Entropy Estimation
papers.tldr: REMEDI improves entropy estimation by fitting a simple base model and estimating a correction for its mismatch with the data distribution.

papers.title: Robustness of Deep Learning for Accelerated MRI: Benefits of Diverse Training Data
papers.tldr: Training MRI reconstruction models on diverse scanners and anatomies improves reported robustness without sacrificing in-distribution performance.

papers.title: Towards Theoretical Understandings of Self-Consuming Generative Models
papers.tldr: Theoretical bounds show conditions under which recursively mixing real and synthetic training data can control generative distribution drift.

papers.title: Vision Transformers as Probabilistic Expansion from Learngene
papers.tldr: PEG samples a compact learngene from a pretrained Vision Transformer and expands it to initialize descendant models at flexible scales.

papers.title: A Benchmark Suite for Evaluating Neural Mutual Information Estimators on Unstructured Datasets
papers.tldr: A new benchmark makes mutual information controllable in image and text datasets so neural estimators can be evaluated on realistic inputs.

papers.title: A Fast Convoluted Story: Scaling Probabilistic Inference for Integer Arithmetics
papers.tldr: A differentiable tensor formulation uses fast Fourier transforms to accelerate probabilistic integer arithmetic and gradient-based learning.

papers.title: A Geometric View of Data Complexity: Efficient Local Intrinsic Dimension Estimation with Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: FLIPD uses diffusion models to estimate local data complexity efficiently, with strong synthetic results and useful but architecture-sensitive image complexity estimates.

papers.title: Cascade of phase transitions in the training of energy-based models
papers.tldr: Analytical and numerical studies show that feature learning in Restricted Boltzmann Machines unfolds through a cascade of thermodynamic phase transitions.

papers.title: Embedding Trajectory for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.tldr: TV score detects unfamiliar mathematical reasoning inputs by measuring volatility in embedding trajectories.

papers.title: Fine-grained Control of Generative Data Augmentation in IoT Sensing
papers.tldr: Conditioning generators on statistical spectrogram properties enables more controlled and effective data augmentation for IoT sensing.

papers.title: Mutual Information Estimation via $f$-Divergence and Data Derangements
papers.tldr: An f-divergence-based estimator uses deranged sample pairings to improve mutual-information accuracy and computational complexity in experiments.

papers.title: On the Identifiability of Hybrid Deep Generative Models: Meta-Learning as a Solution
papers.tldr: The paper analyzes ambiguity in physics–neural generative models and introduces meta-learning formulations with theoretically established identifiability.

papers.title: TabEBM: A Tabular Data Augmentation Method with Distinct Class-Specific Energy-Based Models
papers.tldr: TabEBM trains a separate energy-based generator for each class to produce synthetic tabular data that improves classification, especially on small datasets.

papers.title: Towards a Scalable Reference-Free Evaluation of Generative Models
papers.tldr: FKEA approximates reference-free diversity scores with linear sample-size scaling and interpretable information about generated modes.

papers.title: Transcendence: Generative Models Can Outperform The Experts That Train Them
papers.tldr: A chess model sometimes surpasses every player in its training data, with theory and experiments identifying low-temperature sampling as an enabling mechanism.

papers.title: Wasserstein Gradient Boosting: A Framework for Distribution-Valued Supervised Learning
papers.tldr: Wasserstein gradient boosting extends sequential ensemble learning to distribution-valued predictions and shows competitive uncertainty-quantification performance.

papers.title: A Likelihood Based Approach to Distribution Regression Using Conditional Deep Generative Models
papers.tldr: Likelihood-based conditional generative models achieve convergence rates governed by intrinsic dimension and smoothness when responses concentrate near lower-dimensional structure.

papers.title: A Theory for Conditional Generative Modeling on Multiple Data Sources
papers.tldr: The paper derives conditions under which related data sources give conditional generative models sharper estimation guarantees through joint training.

papers.title: Continuous Visual Autoregressive Generation via Score Maximization
papers.tldr: Strictly proper scoring rules provide a unified framework for autoregressive visual generation without vector quantization.

papers.title: Density Ratio Estimation with Conditional Probability Paths
papers.tldr: A carefully chosen conditioning variable enables a closed-form objective for faster time-score learning and accurate density ratio estimation.

papers.title: Joint Learning of Energy-based Models and their Partition Function
papers.tldr: Jointly learning an energy model and its log-partition enables tractable approximate training in combinatorially large discrete spaces without MCMC.

papers.title: Learning Monotonic Probabilities with a Generative Cost Model
papers.tldr: The paper learns monotonic probabilities by modeling a latent cost variable, with separate generative models for strict and implicit monotonicity.

papers.title: Learning to Match Unpaired Data with Minimum Entropy Coupling
papers.tldr: DDMEC uses cooperating diffusion models to match continuous unpaired data through low joint entropy and relaxed marginal constraints.

papers.title: LOB-Bench: Benchmarking Generative AI for Finance - an Application to Limit Order Book Data
papers.tldr: LOB-Bench evaluates generated order book data through distributional statistics, discriminator scores, and market-impact measures.

papers.title: Multiobjective distribution matching
papers.tldr: An information-geometric framework characterizes Pareto-optimal distribution matching and supports generating images that interpolate across multiple target distributions.

papers.title: Physics-Informed Generative Modeling of Wireless Channels
papers.tldr: Sparse Bayesian generative models learn interpretable wireless-channel distributions from ordinary compressed observations and transfer across system configurations without retraining.

papers.title: Testing Conditional Mean Independence Using Generative Neural Networks
papers.tldr: This conditional mean independence test uses generative networks and a statistic designed to preserve asymptotic accuracy despite slowly decaying estimation errors.

papers.title: Algorithm- and Data-Dependent Generalization Bounds for Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: New generalization bounds for score-based generative models explicitly incorporate the training algorithm, optimization dynamics, and data.

papers.title: Distributional Training Data Attribution: What do Influence Functions Sample?
papers.tldr: Distributional training data attribution accounts for training randomness and gives influence functions a new interpretation without restrictive convexity assumptions.

papers.title: Energy-based generator matching: A neural sampler for general state space
papers.tldr: Energy-based generator matching learns samplers from energy functions without training data across continuous, discrete, and mixed state spaces.

papers.title: Generating Informative Samples for Risk-Averse Fine-Tuning of Downstream Tasks
papers.tldr: Guided diffusion generates high-loss examples that, combined with importance weighting, make risk-averse fine-tuning less noisy and more effective.

papers.title: Generative Distribution Embeddings: Lifting autoencoders to the space of distributions for multiscale representation learning
papers.tldr: Generative distribution embeddings encode sample populations and reconstruct their distributions, supporting multiscale learning and approximate transport geometry.

papers.title: Information Theoretic Learning for Diffusion Models with Warm Start
papers.tldr: A tighter information-theoretic likelihood bound broadens diffusion training to structured noise and delivers strong reported image likelihood results.

papers.title: Learning normalized image densities via dual score matching
papers.tldr: Dual score matching learns normalized image probabilities by training an energy network through both image and noise-level derivatives.

papers.title: Learning with Restricted Boltzmann Machines: Asymptotics of AMP and GD in High Dimensions
papers.tldr: A high-dimensional analysis connects RBM training to multi-index models and establishes optimal weak-recovery thresholds for spiked covariance data.

papers.title: Moment- and Power-Spectrum-Based Gaussianity Regularization for Text-to-Image Models
papers.tldr: A combined moment and power-spectrum loss improves Gaussianity regularization, preventing reward hacking and accelerating convergence in demonstrated image-alignment tasks.

papers.title: Rethinking Approximate Gaussian Inference in Classification
papers.tldr: Replacing softmax enables sampling-free approximations for Gaussian classifier uncertainty, improving evaluated uncertainty quality while removing Monte Carlo overhead.

papers.title: Spectral Convolutional Conditional Neural Processes
papers.tldr: Spectral ConvCNPs use frequency-domain global convolution to capture long-range relationships in probabilistic prediction from observation sets.

papers.title: Stochastic Forward-Forward Learning through Representational Dimensionality Compression
papers.tldr: A dimensionality-based Forward-Forward objective learns from noisy neural responses without prepared negative samples and can benefit from stochasticity.

papers.title: When and how can inexact generative models still sample from the data manifold?
papers.tldr: A dynamical analysis explains how infinitesimal modeling errors can change sample density without pushing samples off the data support.

papers.title: When Does Closeness in Distribution Imply Representational Similarity? An Identifiability Perspective
papers.tldr: Small KL divergence does not guarantee similar representations, but the paper defines a different distributional distance that does within its model framework.

papers.title: A Diffusive Classification Loss for Learning Energy-based Generative Models
papers.tldr: DiffCLF trains energy-based generative models through classification across noise levels, improving energy fidelity while avoiding mode blindness efficiently.

papers.title: Beyond Generative Priors: Minority Sampling with JEPA-Guided Diffusion
papers.tldr: JEPA guidance steers diffusion toward semantically rare examples using a world-model representation as the reference for rarity.

papers.title: Beyond Softmax: A Natural Parameterization for Categorical Random Variables
papers.tldr: Catnat represents categorical probabilities through hierarchical binary choices, with theoretical optimization advantages and improved learning in several applications.

papers.title: Calibrating Generative Models to Distributional Constraints
papers.tldr: Two fine-tuning objectives substantially reduce mismatches between desired and generated distribution statistics across many simultaneous constraints.

papers.title: Data Augmentation of Contrastive Learning is Estimating Positive-incentive Noise
papers.tldr: The paper interprets predefined contrastive augmentations as estimates of beneficial noise and uses that theory to learn augmentations with a noise generator.

papers.title: Deep Single-Index Fréchet Regression
papers.tldr: DeSI combines neural estimation of an interpretable one-dimensional input index with regression for outputs in metric spaces.

papers.title: Dense associative memory for Gaussian distributions
papers.tldr: This paper extends dense associative memory to Gaussian distributions, with storage-capacity proofs and retrieval guarantees under Wasserstein perturbations.

papers.title: DiScoFormer: Plug-In Density and Score Estimation with Transformers
papers.tldr: DiScoFormer learns reusable density and score estimation from samples, connecting Transformer attention to kernel methods and supporting downstream scientific calculations.

papers.title: Efficient Training of Boltzmann Generators Using Off-Policy Log-Dispersion Regularization
papers.tldr: Log-dispersion regularization uses energy labels to improve Boltzmann-generator training without additional on-policy samples.

papers.title: Inverse Entropic Optimal Transport Solves Semi-supervised Learning via Data Likelihood Maximization
papers.tldr: A likelihood-based connection to inverse entropic optimal transport enables conditional-distribution learning from paired and unpaired data together.

papers.title: Latent-Guided Cooperative Energy-Based Models
papers.tldr: Latent guidance and a cooperating generator improve energy-based model training while requiring MCMC sampling only in data space.

papers.title: MOD-SR: Unifying Multimodal Learning and Direct Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion Model for Symbolic Regression
papers.tldr: MOD-SR combines learned expression generation with gradient-guided inference to better connect symbolic regression training with test-time optimization.

papers.title: One-shot Conditional Sampling: MMD meets Nearest Neighbors
papers.tldr: CGMMD learns an adversary-free conditional generator that samples in one forward pass and comes with distributional convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Primal-Spectral Generative Modeling: Fast Analytical Generation via Pseudoinverse Lévy Inversion
papers.tldr: PriSpecNet combines spectral distribution learning with a one-evaluation analytical solver for efficient generation and improved time-series results.

papers.title: Score Correction for Generative Models with Probabilistic Constraints
papers.tldr: DualScore adds a learned score correction to impose probabilistic constraints during sampling without modifying the base generative model.
